name: emph
description:
Emphasis inside translated copy — three roles, styled here rather than in the sentence, because a colour decision living in content lives in every language at once.

`lead` is the default and is only a weight: it used to be four different opacities (80, 82, 85, 88) for one idea, none of which anyone could tell apart. `strong` is the accent highlight. `past` is the life being left behind, struck through and quiet. Dark grounds re-ink `past` at their own call sites — the hero holds it as the light ink at 0.6.

a11y.note: The element is a real `<strong>`, so the emphasis is announced. The struck `past` role also carries the meaning in its copy — the sentence names what is being left behind — so the strike is reinforcement, not the only signal.
